questions.question: What finally happened to Jerusalem and the temple?
options: They were spared by the enemy in return for tribute
The Babylonians burned the temple and broke down the walls
They were sold off to a neighboring foreign king
They were rebuilt far grander and much stronger than ever before
questions.answer: The Babylonians burned the temple and broke down the walls
